source.method: Skyfield ITRS at Earth emission time -> ICRF -> MOON_ME_DE421 at reception -> local ENU -> Three (+east,+up,-north)
source.textureBodyFrame: Three sphere: +X=ITRS Greenwich/equator, +Y=ITRS north pole, +Z=-ITRS 90E/equator; u=0 at longitude -180, u=0.5 at 0
source.ephemerisHashEncoding: UTF-8 JSON with recursively sorted keys and separators comma/colon (Python json.dumps)
source.lightTime: Earth ITRS uses reception UTC minus A's observer-Earth distance / 299792458 m/s; lunar frame uses reception epoch
source.earthRotationTimeScale: UT1 from Skyfield bundled delta-T and leap-second tables (not UT1=UTC); precession/nutation included
source.polarMotion: Not applied; no IERS polar-motion table installed
source.sunDirectionAtEarth: Unit vector Earth(emission).observe(Sun).apparent in reception local Three frame, for visual phase shading only
source.textureEpoch: November 2004 monthly composite; not 2026 weather or live clouds
limits: Rigid spherical visual globe; no Earth oblateness, terrain or dynamic clouds
Orientation uses Skyfield bundled Earth rotation prediction, not an independent precision Earth-orientation solution
No differential aberration or gravitational light-bending deformation of the extended Earth disc
A's apparent topocentric centre position, angular diameter and terrain visibility remain authoritative
Texture includes baked topographic/bathymetric shading; rendered illumination is a visual approximation

interpolation.method: All native 10-minute source epochs compared with hourly shortest-arc quaternion SLERP and normalised linear Earth-to-Sun vectors

input.encoding: six little-endian float32 blocks: Sun az/el/distance, Earth az/el/distance; degrees/metres
